name: biblioteca-app-microservicios
description: BibliotecaApp - Microservicios divididos en Servicio A (Biblioteca) y Servicio B (Estadísticas)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n auth,biblioteca,estadistica,frontend -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "pnpm --filter auth-node dev" "cd ServiceBiblioteca && npm run dev" "cd ServiceEstadistica && npm run dev" "cd BibliotecaFronted && npm run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n auth,biblioteca,estadistica,frontend -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "pnpm --filter auth-node start" "cd ServiceBiblioteca && npm start" "cd ServiceEstadistica && npm start" "cd BibliotecaFronted && npm run preview"
